          "to_next": "Armed with proof of the skim, Rhea decides to weaponize the system's own audit rules."

        "chapter_role": "investigation",
        "goal": "Investigate the local quest payouts and discover that the Ledger's standard rewards are being actively siphoned by a local administrator.",

            "intent": "As the party grinds quests, Rhea notices the math on XP and loot yields doesn't match the System's stated formulas.",

              {

                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "outcome": "Rhea identifies a consistent 14.3% deficit in their quest rewards compared to the raw System formulas.",
                "scene_id": 1,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 25,
                "summary": "The newly formed party takes on a standard gathering quest in the Ash Thickets to test their contract. After completing it, Rhea notices the XP and loot drops are exactly 14.3% lower than the System's stated base rates in the contract syntax.",

                  "rhea_survival",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],

                  "glowing green contract window",
                  "physical quest board",
                  "kiosk chassis",
                  "gray dirt"
                ],

                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "gray dirt",
                  "severed ash-boar tusk",
                  "projected loot table",
                  "kneeling woman"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "She kneels in the gray dirt, comparing the severed ash-boar tusk to the projected loot table hovering above her palm.",
                "type": "progression"
              },

                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 65,
                "summary": "Rhea forces Unit 734 to pull up the historical logs for the last fifty local quests. She cross-references the data, compiling a makeshift ledger on a piece of scrap parchment that proves the local node is mathematically skimming off the top.",

                  "system_debt_trap",
                  "party_alliance"

                  "scrap parchment",
                  "charcoal stick",
                  "undeniable deficit",
                  "rolled document"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "She rolls up the scrap parchment, tapping the charcoal stick against her chin as she stares at the undeniable deficit.",
                "type": "investigation"
              }
            ],

            "title": "Mathematical Discrepancies"
          },

                  "kiosk screen"

                  "blue conduit"

                  "brass terminal",
                  "etched account tag",
                  "narrowed eyes"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Rhea traces the thickest glowing cable from the terminal, her eyes narrowing at the administrator's personal account tag etched into the brass.",
                "type": "investigation"
              }
            ],

            "title": "Tracking the Leak"
          },

                "summary": "The terminal's automated defense system detects their intrusion and begins a localized memory wipe to destroy the logs. Rhea frantically works to extract the raw data packet while Vance physically holds the terminal's cooling vents open to prevent a hard reset.",

                  "memory wipe protocol"

                "transition_in_text": "A shrill alarm pierces the damp chamber as the brass terminal flashes red, initiating a localized memory wipe protocol.",

                  "scorching cooling vents",
                  "stone floor",
                  "glowing data crystal",
                  "cursing man"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Vance releases the scorching cooling vents with a curse, dropping to the stone floor as Rhea clutches the glowing data crystal.",
                "type": "puzzle"
              },

                "characters": [

                  "vance_harrow",

                "constraint_state": "free",

                "summary": "With the data crystal in hand, Rhea realizes the local system will try to delete it from her standard inventory. She exploits a loophole in their new custom party contract to bind the crystal as a 'Soul-Bound Liability,' locking it into her unalterable personal System inventory.",

                "transition_in_anchors": [

                  "decaying durability meter",
                  "open palm"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The red alarm lights fade to a dull amber as Rhea stares at the pulsing data crystal in her palm, watching its durability meter rapidly decay.",

              }
            ],
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "Securing the Evidence"
          }
        ],
